answer: Sponsored admission, reputation decay: a newcomer enters only on a 200-credit sponsor stake, and the identity is one opal that brightens only with honest work — no one can forge an opal overnight. It decays 10% each idle epoch, so idle fakes sink to their nadir and expire. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors and 200,000 locked credits; any fake's misbehavior slashes its sponsor too. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
